entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5 15-05-2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. Vide order dated 13.12.2023 the matter was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Center of the Patna High Court to amicably resolve the dispute between the parties.

The learned Mediator has submitted its report dated 28.03.2024 Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56856 of 2023(5)
dt.15-05-2024 in which it is clearly stated that the dispute between the parties has been resolved and the terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them is being attached with this report.

5. In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on Chhotu Paswan vs The State Of Bihar on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90375727/
1 furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No.66 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) Trivedi/-
U T Chhotu Paswan vs The State Of Bihar on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90375727/
2
